notes.subject: to David's servants / to the reader
notes.rationale: David's answer is direct speech addressing those who asked why he fasted.

notes.subject: odam kaј nego
notes.rationale: 'I shall go to him' — death, to the child in sheol; some read it as merely 'I will die too', others as hope of reunion.

notes.subject: da go vratam ⟨se⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew להשיבו already contains the object pronoun 'him'; Macedonian needs the reflexive 'се' supplied and bracketed.

notes.subject: הלך אליו / ישוב אלי
notes.rationale: Mirror symmetry of 'go to him / return to me' with שׁוּב and אל — chiastic reversal preserved in word order.

translation: А сега, кога умре, зошто ова — јас да постам? Можам ли уште да го вратам ⟨се⟩? Јас одам кај него, а тој нема да се врати кај мене.
